description: This file manages Endpoint Profiles in a wireless device, including creation, deletion, configuration validation, and security checks. It defines functions for setting defaults, adding/removing profile instances, reconfiguration, and security validation.

methods.name: s_setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default values for a new Endpoint Profile, initializing security, identifiers, and status fields.

methods.name: s_addEpProfileInst_oaf
methods.description: Creates a new Endpoint Profile instance, links it to the endpoint, and initializes it with default settings.

methods.name: _wld_endpoint_deleteProfileInstance_odf
methods.description: Deletes an Endpoint Profile instance, cleans up references, and frees memory.

methods.name: s_doEpReconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures an endpoint based on its interface index.

methods.name: wld_epProfile_delete
methods.description: Deletes a given Endpoint Profile from its endpoint, updates current profile if needed, and frees resources.

methods.name: wld_epProfile_fromIt
methods.description: Retrieves Endpoint Profile data from an iterator.

methods.name: _wld_ep_setProfileConf_ocf
methods.description: Handles configuration events for Endpoint Profiles.

methods.name: _wld_ep_setProfileSecurityConf_ocf
methods.description: Handles security configuration events for Endpoint Profiles.

methods.name: s_checkEpProfileSecConf
methods.description: Validates the security configuration of an Endpoint Profile.

methods.name: wld_epProfile_hasValidConf
methods.description: Checks if an Endpoint Profile has a valid configuration, including SSID and security settings.
